item.summary: feat(ui): add live CPU/memory/delay sparkline graphs to the system busyness overlay (#127650) * feat(ui): add cpu/memory graphs to system busyness overlay * refactor(ui): redesign busyness overlay vitals as sparkline stat tiles Merge the duplicated sparkline row and numeric tile grid into three vital tiles (CPU, memory, event-loop delay) with gradient area charts, a live pulse dot, pointer scrubbing with value+age readout, and a danger tint driven by the gateway's own event-loop degradation reasons. Memory auto-ranges its baseline so RSS trends stay visible.
